title: Documents library
subtitle: Reports, research, decks and images the assistant can read when you name them in a chat.
configureFirst: Connect the API endpoint in Administration → General first.
readOnly: You can read this library. Adding or changing items needs the editor or admin role in this workspace.

intro.label: About the library
intro.notFeedback: Library items are reference documents, not feedback: they never reach metrics, sentiment or categories. To import feedback from a CSV or JSON file, use
intro.mention: In the assistant, type # and an item's short name (for example #q3-market) to put that document into the chat.

toolbar.label: Filter the library
toolbar.searchPlaceholder: Search titles, short names, sources and tags

list.label: Library items
list.loadFailed: The library could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
list.noMatch: No library items match these filters.

empty.title: No documents yet
empty.text: Upload a report, a survey export, a deck or an image once, and name it in any chat with # and its short name.
empty.textReadOnly: Nobody has added a document to this library yet.

upload.title: Upload to the library
upload.description: Each file becomes one library item. Its text is read once, after the upload.
upload.dropHint: Drop files here, or choose them.
upload.limits: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV, HTML, text, Markdown, or a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image. Files up to 25 MB, images up to 3.75 MB.

phase.done: Uploaded. Its text is being read: the list shows when it is ready.

refused.unsupported: This file type is not supported. Upload one of: {{accepted}}.
refused.tooLarge: This file is larger than 25 MB, the most a library item can be.
refused.imageTooLarge: This image is larger than 3.75 MB, the most an image can be.

fields.title: Title
fields.slugHint: What you type after # in a chat: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens. Left empty, it is made from the title.
fields.tagsHint: Separated by commas, for example: market, q3.
fields.badSlug: A short name is 1 to 64 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, and starts and ends with a letter or digit.
fields.tooManyTags: An item has at most {{max, number}} tags.
fields.tagTooLong: A tag is at most {{max, number}} characters.

errors.slugTaken: Another library item already has this short name. Choose another.
errors.libraryFull: This library holds 1,000 items, its most. Delete some first.
errors.unsupported: This file type is not supported.
errors.tooLarge: This file is too large: files can be at most 25 MB, images at most 3.75 MB.
errors.stale: This item was changed since you opened it. Reload it and try again.
errors.notUploaded: The file did not arrive. Try again.
errors.uploadMismatch: The uploaded file is not the one announced. Try again.
errors.writeForbidden: Adding or changing library items needs the editor or admin role in this workspace.
errors.deleteForbidden: Only an admin or the person who uploaded it can delete this item.
errors.notFound: This library item no longer exists.
errors.notFailed: Only a failed item can be read again.
errors.uploadRefused: The file could not be uploaded. Try again.
errors.network: The upload stopped: check your connection and try again.

preview.title: Library item
preview.loadFailed: This item could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
preview.notFound: This library item does not exist, or it was deleted.
preview.pending: Waiting for its file. If the upload did not finish, delete this item and upload the file again.
preview.extracting: Its text is being read. This page updates when it is ready.
preview.failed: Its text could not be read.
preview.mentionHint: Type {{slug}} in the assistant to put this document into a chat.

details.native: The file itself, when it is named in a chat
details.passages: The passages of its text that match the question

text.title: Text
text.loadFailed: The text could not be loaded. Try again.
text.empty: No text was found on this page.
text.truncated: This document is very long: only its first part was read.

delete.title: Delete this library item?
delete.message: "{{title}}" is deleted for good, with its file and its text. Chats that named it keep what they said.
